    "71c9f4fe: ;\nThis routine is used to edit the DICTATED DATE field (field #10.01)\nin the EXAMINATION file (#393). It sets up and controls the\nsequence of execution of input templates and other logic.\n;",
    "f4ea2574: ;Call input transform for DICTATED DATE field",
    "c0fb931a: ;Initialize variables and check if subfile data exists",
    "30d9f9c1: ;If DICTATED DATE already exists, set DE(1) to existing value",
    "e811c815: ;Clean up variables",
    "287f833f: ;Write data label for field being edited",
    "ca75a0a0: ;No additional logic",
    "ab54cbda: ;Call directory utility to handle output formatting",
    "ad4a2bc2: ;Check if word-wrapping is needed for long values",
    "cf6a4b77: ;No editing allowed for COMPUTED fields",
    "a7c0343c: ;Read user's response and handle timeout",
    "90f1769b: ;No additional logic",
    "78d64664: ;Increment input template sequence number",
    "ac479649: ;Branch to the next input template",
    "a5edde5c: ;If existing data, go to prompt. Otherwise read new entry.",
    "071d0735: If X is blank, branch to the A label if DV does not contain an 'R', branch to X if DV is empty, or branch to A if D is less than or equal to 0.",
    "6febe754: If X starts with '?', branch to the QS label (Query String).",
    "ecc1bc63: If X is '@', execute the code at the Z^DIE2 label.",
    "7e2f18b0: If X is a space and DV contains 'd' but not 'P', and there is a default value for the current field label in ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB), set X to that default value. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the default value preceded by two spaces.",
    "dc574dfd: If DV is not empty, branch to M^DIE17. If DV contains 'V', branch to ^DIE3. If DV does not contain 'S', branch to P. If there is code in ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute it. Set % to the second piece of the semicolon-delimited string DU, with X as the delimiter. Set Y to X. If % is not empty and there is code in DIC('S'), execute it. If DB(DQ) is not defined, write '  ' followed by %. Branch to V.",
    "3bfc55d3: Loop through the semicolon-delimited pieces of DU. Set Y to the current piece, and DG to the position of the substring ':X' within Y. If Y is empty, branch to X. Set YS to Y, and Y to the piece before the colon. If DG is not zero and there is code in DIC('S'), execute it. If DG is zero, continue to the next iteration of the loop.",
    "968d7f9f: If DB(DQ) is not defined, write the substring of YS starting from the position DG to the end. Set X to the piece of YS before the colon.",
    "667996c0: If DV contains 'P', set DIC to the concatenation of U and DU, and set DIC(0) based on the value of DB(DQ) and whether DV contains the single quote character. If DIC(0) contains 'L', set DLAYGO to the second piece of DV delimited by 'P'. If DV does not contain '*', execute ^DIC. Set X to the value of Y, and set DIC to DIE. If X is less than 0, branch to X.",
    "d5f5a2d3: If DV does not contain 'N', branch to V. Execute the code at the D label. If the length of the piece of X after the decimal point is greater than 24, kill X and branch to Z.",
    "c34db6df: If the second piece of DV delimited by ',' is non-zero, X contains a decimal point, and the fifth piece of DQ(DQ) delimited by U does not start with '$', perform several transformations on X: If X starts with '00', set X to an empty string. If the first character of X is 0, set X to the substring starting from the second character. Otherwise, leave X as is. If the last character of the piece of X after the decimal point is 0, remove that character from X. If the piece of X after the decimal point is empty and X contains a decimal point, set X to its numeric value.",
    "e17533cf: Execute the code at the label 'X' concatenated with DQ. Kill the variable YS.",
    "7d63ff0c: Kill DIC('S') and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not equal to U, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB) to X. Branch to A.",
    "61792b34: Write a bell character and '??'. If DB(DQ) is defined, branch to Z^DIE17.",
    "3509a93d: Set X to '?BAD'.",
    "a78d66bc: Set DZ to X. Execute the code at the D and QQ",
    "ea6bd9b2: ;Set up the input variables",
    "d267fc1b: ;If no existing value, display it. If '^' entered, quit. If '@' entered and not a required field, go to next field.",

    "d0e71795: ;If a pointer value: get the pointer description",
    "55e04229: ;If a pointer to a MUMPS array.",
    "f7eddded: ;If this is a set of codes data attribute, get the external code value.",
    "3c3b79a2: ;If no entry and either reader or '??' allowed, display '??'. If no reader and '??' required display '?BAD'",
